landing.heroSubtitle: Create, share and develop teaching materials together – simply, securely and aligned with Lehrplan 21.
landing.forTeachers: Exclusively for active and former teachers.
landing.featureReposDesc: Version, fork and share your materials like a pro.
landing.featureSecureDesc: All files are stored encrypted. Access only for authorised persons.
landing.featureCurriculumDesc: Metadata tailored to the Swiss school system: subject, level, cycle, language.
landing.featureRatingDesc: Quality through community feedback and moderation.
landing.infoOnlyTeachers: The platform is reserved for teachers. New registrations are reviewed in advance.

auth.registerNotice: Your account will be activated after review by a teacher (admin/moderator).
auth.resetRequestDesc: You will receive an email with a reset link.
auth.pendingDesc: Your account has been created and is awaiting activation by a team member. You will receive an email as soon as you can log in.
auth.deleteAccountDesc: Your account will be deactivated and reactivatable for 30 days. You can transfer your materials to another person.

help.repoAccess: Choose “Free download” so everyone can download. Choose “Approval required” to control access per person.
